parser.derivation: No vendored upstream source. The RTF tokenizer, bounded scanner, group/destination tracking, control-word and hex-escape handling, \uN resolution, objdata decoding, and audit heuristics are original hand-rolled Turen code written for this target.

derivation: Bounded wasm-bindgen wrapper exposing four operations over a hand-rolled RTF scanner: rtf_inspect (group tree, control-word histogram, font/style/color tables, generator, info metadata, pictures, datastore, file table), rtf_objects (embedded object class, dimensions, bounded objdata hex decode, SHA-256, OLE compound-magic detection), rtf_audit (exploit-document findings: objdata payloads, OLE classes, file tables, template paths, field instructions, protection markers, obfuscation, hex-heavy regions, deep nesting, unbalanced braces, trailing data, mixed encodings), and rtf_text (bounded plain-text extraction with \'hh and \uN resolution). Runtime crates are used unmodified via exact-pinned crates.io releases committed in Cargo.lock.
